items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: So in fact the bass player I have in my band now, Greg Cohen, plays with John Zorn’s band also.

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s the tune all right. And “New York New York” you know and stuff like that. But I think on that job they left them alone though. That was a kind of a nice job. But I couldn’t believe that. It’s really surprising around New York, the people you run into in the most unexpected places. But that’s the beauty of it too because you keep meeting new faces and new musical circles. There’s all these little groups around New York that do different things. And one guy plays not only in this group of people but in…
